aggregation.cell_metric: equal-weight arithmetic mean across the five predeclared folds
aggregation.primary_rationale: reporting follows the field's canonical metric per task family (binary and nominal multiclass on AUROC, ordinal grading on quadratic-weighted kappa, survival on the concordance index); selection everywhere remains the primary validation metric and is never a test quantity
aggregation.qwk_recording_rule: quadratic-weighted kappa is recorded clamped at 0 (kappa is defined on [-1, 1] while every sealed consumer requires [0, 1]); the raw value remains recoverable from the sealed summary block and persisted predictions
aggregation.survival_scale_rule: aggregate fold-level c-index values; never pool raw risks across independently trained folds

agent_resources.missingness: report unavailable explicitly; never coerce it to zero
agent_resources.unit: the one locked coding-agent session assigned to each cell

agentic_lift.contrast: frozen autoMIL winner minus native baseline within the same cell
agentic_lift.scale_rule: magnitude summaries are always per task family (each family has exactly one reporting metric and metrics are not interchangeable); only sign counts may be pooled across families
agentic_lift.unit: one predeclared cell identified only by dataset, task, encoder, arm, seed, and protocol_version

search_process.candidate_class_scope: failure-inclusive census of the 30 launched and charged attempts; submit-time refusals are not launched attempts and remain framework validation evidence rather than campaign outcomes
discovery_fields: terminal status, reason, budget-killed fact, and deterministically derived outcome class
elapsed seconds and peak VRAM with explicit missingness
promotion_fields: the exact stable top-10 unique discovery roster and all of its frozen promotion jobs
elapsed seconds and peak VRAM with explicit missingness
search_process.resource_aggregation: report the five-fold native baseline, three-fold discovery, and two-fold promotion as separate strata; elapsed_seconds/3600 is named GPU-attached job-hours (not measured accelerator utilization), and any cross-stage agentic-search value is an observed total labelled a lower bound when attempts lack timing
search_process.timing: process evidence is hashed into the 130-cell selection freeze before any held-out value is opened
search_process.unit: one predeclared cell with exactly 30 discovery attempts and at most 10 promotion jobs

tile_ranking_response.pooling_rule: rank statistics are scale-free, so the classification stratum deliberately pools blocks ranked on test_auc with the ordinal grade blocks ranked on test_qwk; every block row carries its task_family and primary_metric so the mixture stays visible

titan_lift.contrast: frozen TITAN-lineage winner minus native TITAN baseline
titan_lift.restriction: reported separately; never ranked against tile-feature arms

inference.multiplicity_adjustment: not applicable because no null-hypothesis tests are declared
inference.scope: descriptive inference over the complete frozen 130-cell census
inference.warning: shared patients, cohorts, encoders, tasks, and one seed prohibit treating 130 cells or five folds as independent samples

missingness.policy: fail closed; do not emit a publication report from an incomplete or inconsistent campaign

ranking.top_arm_definition: the complete set tied at the maximum primary metric
